cves.description: Fast, auditable Linux mitigation for CVE-2026-31431 Copy Fail: algif_aead block, verification, and AF_ALG seccomp hardening.

Archived, moved to codesource/cve-check. Shell script to detect CVE-2026-31431 (Copy Fail) exposure and mitigations on Linux systems: kernel check, module state, boot params, AF_ALG reachability, and distro patch status.
